1	"""Stateful replay preparation.
     2	
     3	A preparation is a path of enabled transitions from the initial state to the
     4	recovered desired state.  Guards are evaluated on the recovered entry inputs
     5	(including the desired state), never on an intermediate simulation state, so
     6	the set of enabled transitions is constant for one record.
     7	
     8	Among all usable paths the minimiser of `(sum of costs, number of commands,
     9	command sequence lexicographically)` is required exactly.  It is found with a
    10	reverse Dijkstra over `(cost, commands)` followed by a forward greedy walk
    11	that always takes the smallest command which still admits an optimal
    12	completion; every state on an optimal path is strictly closer to the target
    13	than the initial state, so the walk is well defined.  States are numbered
    14	internally so the search only touches integers.
    15	"""

    20	# Distances are packed as `cost * SHIFT + commands` so that the priority queue
    21	# compares one integer and the greedy walk can decode both components.  A
    22	# shortest path is simple, so its command count stays far below SHIFT.
    23	_SHIFT_BITS = 17
    24	_SHIFT = 1 << _SHIFT_BITS

    37	            raise InvalidCampaign("too many states")

    40	                    or not state.isprintable() or len(state) > 64:
    41	                raise InvalidCampaign("state name must be printable ASCII")

    44	        self.states = list(states)
